items.title: The actual weighted weak resolvent satisfies an ordinary distribution Laplace equation

source.anchor: PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Section2.2 equations2.6-2.14 actual reflected conditional law and AppendixC.1 LemmaB.1/C.1 omitted weighted-H1 analytic prerequisite. SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 BL dependency route only; the ordinary PDE is not a quoted numbered source theorem.
source.attribution: Samplinglib explicit ordinary weak elliptic prerequisite to Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang AppendixC.1; not a quoted numbered theorem or complete LemmaC.1/Poincare result.

items.statement: For actual mu=volume.tilted(-W), the same exact closable compact smooth gradient D, every epsilon>0 and genuine L2(mu) forcing f, construct u in D.closure.domain satisfying the all-domain variational equation. Its actual G=D.closure u is the ordinary weak gradient, with locally volume-integrable u/G and every C1 compact directional identity and both integrable products. Put k=epsilon u+inner(gradient W,G)-f. Prove locally integrable squared norm of k and actual u/G/k in L2(volume.restrict K) for every compact K. For every C2 compact phi, both u Delta phi and k phi are integrable for volume and integral u Delta phi = integral k phi. This is a distribution identity, not a classical Laplacian of arbitrary u.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure and canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero. W is C1 and exp(-W) is genuinely integrable for volume; mu is exactly volume.tilted(-W).

D is the same real-linear partial gradient on actual L2(mu), closable with original graph exactly compact smooth scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, identified mu-a.e. Epsilon is positive and forcing f is a genuine scalar L2(mu) class. Neither a weak solution, test-domain membership, ordinary PDE nor local-L2 certificate is supplied.

All ordinary weak derivatives, compact restrictions and distribution test integrals use volume; the variational identity uses actual L2(mu). The actual closed gradient G=D.closure u and the same u serve every test/compact. C2 compact tests suffice; no regularity of the selected L2 representative u is assumed.

formulae.label: The actual weighted weak resolvent satisfies an ordinary distribution Laplace equation
formulae.tex: \mu=Z_W^{-1}e^{-W}dx,\quad G=\overline Du,\quad k=\varepsilon u+\langle\nabla W,G\rangle-f;\quad u,G,k\in L^2_{\rm loc}(dx),\quad\int u\Delta\phi\,dx=\int k\phi\,dx\ (\phi\in C_c^2).
